games.title: Snake Runner
games.description: Guide the snake through endless obstacles. Collect food, grow longer, and survive as long as you can in this fast-paced arcade challenge.

games.title: Neon Breaker
games.description: Smash through neon blocks with a glowing paddle. Fast reflexes and precise aim required to clear every level.

games.title: Space Blast
games.description: Defend the galaxy from incoming alien waves. Blast enemies, dodge fire, and survive the cosmic onslaught.
games.controls: Arrow keys to move, Space to shoot

games.title: Cyber Slope
games.description: Race down a neon-lit cyber slope at breakneck speed. Dodge barriers and collect boosters to set a new record.

games.title: Pixel Dungeon
games.description: Explore a retro pixelated dungeon filled with traps and treasure. Find the exit before time runs out.

games.title: Retro Racer
games.description: Classic top-down racing action. Overtake rivals, take tight corners, and cross the finish line first.

games.title: Void Rift
games.description: Manipulate portals and bend space to solve challenging puzzles. Think in dimensions to escape the void.

games.title: Neon Pong
games.description: A neon-styled twist on the classic paddle game. Challenge the AI in fast, glowing rallies.
